It defines the radius of the imaginary sphere around a point $x$ for ambient illumination calculation.
**Polygon Processing:** For each polygon $P$ with vertices $\{\vec{p}_0, \dots, \vec{p}_{k-1}\}$, compute its contribution to the ambient occlusion volume.
**Fractional Obscurance:** To avoid hard cutoffs at distance $\delta$, binary occlusion is replaced with fractional obscurance.
The visibility function $V(\hat{\omega}_i)$ is 1 if there is an unoccluded line of sight between $x$ and $x+\hat{\omega}_i\delta$, and 0 otherwise.
**Volume Rendering/Storage:** The contributions from all polygons are accumulated into the 3D texture.
- **Memory Complexity:** Depends on the resolution of the 3D texture.
- **When to Use:** When real-time performance is required and the scene consists of dynamic triangle meshes.
- **When Not to Use:** When high accuracy is required for thin, stacked objects or when curved surfaces cannot be tessellated.
